rows.question: What did the Finance Minister say about capital expenditure?
rows.answer:
### Direct answer
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said that the government will continue to prioritise capital expenditure to sustain India’s growth momentum while ensuring fiscal discipline. Speaking at HSBC India’s Third Annual Financial Inclusion Gathering in Mumbai, Sitharaman said capital expenditure had delivered good results over the past four to five years through its multiplier effect and would remain an important part of the government’s growth strategy. [S1]
### Detailed explanation
Addressing the balance between welfare commitments and fiscal consolidation, the Finance Minister highlighted the role of government schemes in improving access to basic services, including food security, housing, sanitation, drinking water and healthcare insurance. Sitharaman also identified credit access, insurance and pensions as priorities for the next phase of financial inclusion. She reiterated the government’s goal of achieving insurance coverage for all by 2047 and said credit access was important for people seeking to start or expand businesses. On employment and skills, she said the government wanted every district to have AI training-capable centers to prepare young people for AI-enabled jobs and address the gap between industry requirements and the skills of graduates. [S1]

rows.question: What is ISRO's CMS-03 satellite?
rows.answer:
### Direct answer
Vice President C P Radhakrishnan and Prime Minister Narendra Modi have congratulated Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and Indian Navy on the successful launch of India’s heaviest communication satellite, CMS-03. In a social media post, Vice President Radhakrishnan highlighted how India’s mighty LVM3-M5 rocket roared to the skies once again with the successful launch of GSAT-7R (CMS-03). He pointed out that it is now the heaviest and most advanced communication satellite for the Indian Navy placed into Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO). [S1]
### Detailed explanation
The Vice President mentioned that this indigenously developed satellite will strengthen space-based communications, connectivity, and maritime domain awareness across the Indian Ocean Region. He called it another proud milestone in Atmanirbhar Bharat and said that ISRO continues to script remarkable milestones in space exploration. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Modi commended how the space sector has become synonymous with excellence and innovation. He highlighted that these successes fueled by the nation’s space scientists have furthered national progress and empowered countless lives. [S1]
### Related coverage
- "India Launches Heaviest Military Communication Satellite CMS-03 from Sriharikota" (2025-11-02): India’s space agency ISRO successfully launched the LVM3-M5 rocket from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota today at 5:35 pm. The rocket carried CMS-03, the country’s heaviest communication satellite ever sent to space. It marked the fifth operational flight of the LVM3 launcher. [S2]
